title: yamaa 1.0 function file
description: One file of the 1.0 function type. Each field carries its kind as x-yamaa-kind and its schema-notation type as x-yamaa-type. Generated from yaml/v1/ by tools/packaging/generate_json_schema.py.

function_case_id.description: Name of one function test case (FUNC-11).

function_coverage.description: Obligation a function test case demonstrates (FUNC-11).

yamaa.description: Oldest language version this function file needs, always quoted (SCHEMA-2).

type.description: File type of a function file, which defines one project function (FUNC-4).

name.description: Logical name a specification calls the function by (FUNC-4).

description.description: Description of what the function computes (FUNC-4).

params.description: Closed, ordered named parameters of the function (FUNC-5).

returns.description: Column type of the one scalar the function returns (FUNC-9).

may_return_missing.description: Whether an invoked binding may return the missing value (FUNC-9).

comparison_decimals.description: Decimal places at which numeric test results are compared (FUNC-13).

implementations.description: Statically written fully qualified callable each host language binds, by language key (FUNC-8).

tests.description: Inline test cases activation runs before any study data is read (FUNC-11).

name.description: Parameter name, matching the callable's parameter exactly (FUNC-5).

type.description: Exact type every argument and default of this parameter has (FUNC-5).

required.description: Whether a call must supply this argument (FUNC-5).

default.description: Value an omitted optional argument takes (FUNC-7).

accepts_missing.description: Whether a missing argument is passed to the binding instead of short-circuiting the call (FUNC-7).

id.description: Unique name of the test case (FUNC-11).

args.description: Logical arguments the case passes, by parameter name (FUNC-11).

result.description: Result the call is expected to return (FUNC-11).

function_value.description: Constant of the declared parameter or return type, a date or datetime written as bare text and YAML null for missing (FUNC-5).

host_language.description: Host language a callable belongs to.

identifier.description: Single-token identifier; the field's own description states which naming list it belongs to, such as a declared dataset, a declared column, a document or a function (SPEC-2).

language_version.description: Language version a file declares in `yamaa`, the oldest that admits every field it writes (SCHEMA-2).

literal_value.description: Scalar constant in which YAML null is the missing value; a non-finite float becomes missing (VALUE-4).

qualified_callable.description: Fully qualified callable name, such as projectbmi.bmi or projectbmi::bmi (FUNC-8).
